items: Read it twice. Still no slides.

slides.b: Who, what happened, when. Three lines. They've read it too, so don't retell it.
One sentence: what the company had to decide. Everything after answers it.
SWOT or Porter's Five Forces, not both. One slide, four or five boxes, short phrases.
Two or three options with one pro and one con each. Then say which one you'd choose and why.
What any company could learn from this case. Then take questions.

Tell Toso the case and the course. Get the finished slides in PowerPoint.
First deck free. M-Pesa, no card, no monthly bill.
